title: Design System: MMD XR Stage — VR HUD

title.purpose: Recovery and diagnostic titles; sizes are Canvas pixels.

body.purpose: Paged detail text, with 48 texture-pixel baseline spacing.

button-active.purpose: Weight change for active buttons and tabs.

motion.name: press-scale
motion.purpose: Immediate mesh scale on press; no easing duration. Hover/press also multiplies the texture by the selected tint.

components.name: Ordinary Action
components.description: Illustrative flat texture-scale preview. XR geometry supplies rounding; CSS hover approximates tint and focus is preview-only. All tonal ramps are synthesized preview metadata, not shipping tokens.

components.name: Selected Action
components.description: Pale selection with stronger cobalt text; hover overlay illustrates the material tint.

components.name: Quiet Action
components.description: Header/back/exit action merges into the porcelain panel at rest.

components.name: Category Tabs
components.description: Default and active tab states; active indicator is half the texture width, four pixels high, starting six pixels above the bottom edge.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs" aria-label="设置分类"><button>模型 / 物件</button><button aria-current="page">画面</button><button>物理</button><button>操作</button></nav>

components.name: Danger Action
components.description: Destructive actions and critical notices use semantic carmine rather than cobalt.

components.name: Disabled Action
components.description: Explicit unavailable text/fill; no hover tint. Active disabled actions retain active font weight.

components.name: Porcelain Panel
components.description: Scaled texture swatch of the 1320 × 1120 backdrop. Actual XR geometry is 2.76 × 2.24 local units expanded or 1.95 × 0.84 compact; compact omits rules.
components.html: <svg class="ds-panel" viewBox="0 0 1320 1120" role="img" aria-label="Porcelain panel texture"><rect width="1320" height="1120" rx="32" fill="#edf1f6"/><path d="M40 112H1280 M40 1002H1280" fill="none" stroke="#ccd5e2" stroke-width="1"/></svg>

components.name: Parameter Value
components.description: Texture-scale example: muted name left, stronger value right; no input field or enclosing card.

components.name: Adjustment Slider
components.description: Static geometry swatch at value 0.5, not a functioning XR control. ViewBox scales local geometry by 1000; transparent target is 0.86 × 0.16 for the default 0.74-wide track. Disabled opacity is 0.45.

narrative.overview:
The user-selected direction is cool porcelain, ink typography and restrained cobalt selection. Quiet, flat controls support a Quest 3S viewer who mainly watches and occasionally adjusts settings with controllers.

This system applies only to the VR HUD in `src/mmdVrShowcase/hud/hudAppearance.ts` and `src/mmdVrShowcase/hud/MmdVrHud.tsx`. The preparation page in `src/styles/mmd-vr-prep.css` uses the warm white and deep green window-lit studio palette. The stage background, grid and placement aid use dedicated colours independent of legacy user accents.
keyCharacteristics: Cool porcelain surfaces with ink labels.
Selection through tint, weight and a small tab indicator.
Flat, rounded controls with controller-sized targets.
Code-painted textures; no shipped raster assets.

rules.name: The HUD Boundary Rule
rules.body: HUD tokens never become global preparation-page or stage colors.

dos: Do keep HUD colors independent of preparation, stage and model colors.
Do distinguish texture pixels from local XR geometry units.
Do preserve readable labels, explicit selected states and controller target sizes.
Do report emulator evidence separately from pending Quest hardware validation.
donts: Don't add expensive blur, bevels or real 3D shadows to the HUD.
Don't replace restrained selection with full-panel accent fills.
Don't ship review screenshots as product assets or claim headset success from them.
